description: This C# source file defines the ViewMediaFolderAuthorizationHandler class, which manages authorization logic for viewing media folders within OrchardCore, including handling permissions for root, media fields, user folders, and specific subfolders with dynamic permissions.

classes.name: ViewMediaFolderAuthorizationHandler
classes.description: Handles authorization for viewing media folders, including root, media fields, user-specific folders, and dynamic folder permissions.

methods.name: HandleRequirementAsync
methods.description: Main method that processes authorization requests based on folder paths and permissions.

methods.name: AuthorizeAttachedMediaFieldsFolderAsync
methods.description: Handles authorization for media attached to content items or temporary files within media fields.

methods.name: AuthorizeUsersFolderAsync
methods.description: Handles authorization logic for user media folders, including own and others' media.

methods.name: AuthorizeAsync
methods.description: Performs the actual authorization check using the authorization service and marks context as secure if applicable.

methods.name: IsAuthorizedFolder
methods.description: Checks if a given path exactly matches an authorized folder.

methods.name: IsDescendantOfAuthorizedFolder
methods.description: Checks if a path is a descendant of an authorized folder.

methods.name: EnsureTrailingSlash
methods.description: Ensures a folder path ends with a slash and is normalized.
